source.prompt: A dry foley recording, not music: wind rustling through the leaves of trees in soft gusts on a hillside, with an occasional distant small bird chirp. Continuous for the whole duration. No melody, no musical instruments, no rhythm, no voices. Duration: 40 seconds.
